task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, travel south. And then, go to the south. After that, take the keycard from the bed within the lounge. That's it!
description:
You arrive in a studio. A typical kind of place.



You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, it is unblocked.

feedback:
Guess what, you are in a place we're calling a laundromat. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.

You can see a closed typical looking basket right there by you. You can make out a shelf. The shelf appears to be empty. You think about smashing the shelf to bits, throwing the bits in the dump, etc, until you get bored.

You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked. You don't like doors? Why not try going south, that entranceway is unblocked. There is an unguarded exit to the west.
